author: Yffe
content: Fixed in f0ceb12 (single file: thermite-syntax/src/parser.rs). Root cause: the #29 depth bound lived only in parse_expr; four families recursed without routing through it. Generalised to one shared guard_recursion helper + unified recursion_depth/MAX_RECURSION_DEPTH (kept 64). Guarded re-entries: parse_expr, parse_type (Option<...>), parse_pattern (covers both [[...]] slice and Some(Some(..)) enum cycles), parse_if_parts (parse_block<->parse_if_parts tail-if). On limit returns the existing structured SyntaxError::ExpressionTooDeep — never aborts. All four divergence_reaudit tests now return on a 2 MiB stack and are un-ignored; the existing divergence_grammar deep-paren test and depth-40 reasonable nesting still parse. Gauntlet: cargo test -p thermite-syntax 16 passed / 0 failed / 0 ignored (9 conformance + 3 divergence_grammar + 4 divergence_reaudit); clippy --all-targets -D warnings PASS; fmt --all --check PASS. Touched neither test assertions nor any conformance/ fixture (only the four #[ignore] attrs removed).
